title: AQSh spot Bitcoin ETF: haftada $986,9 mln, uch haftada $3,8 mlrd
summary: SoSoValue: 5-sentabrda yakunlangan haftada AQSh spot BTC ETF lari $986,9 mln sof kirim. Oxirgi uch hafta $3,8 mlrd — 2026-yilning eng kuchli uch haftalik seriyasi.
body:
AQSh spot Bitcoin ETF lari 5-sentabrda yakunlangan savdo haftasida $986,9 million sof kirim yozdi. SoSoValue ma’lumotiga ko‘ra, oxirgi uch haftalik yig‘indi $3,8 milliardga yetdi — 2026-yildagi eng kuchli ketma-ket uch haftalik oqim.

Payshanba (3-sentabr) $730,8–731 mln bilan 14-yanvardan beri eng yirik kun bo‘ldi. Juma (4-sentabr) kirim $174,6 mln ga tushdi: IBIT $117,4 mln (~67%), FBTC $57,2 mln. Jami net aktivlar $101,3 mlrd (oldingi kuni ~$103,3 mlrd), kumulativ kirim $55,6 mlrd.

Yil boshidan net oqim hali ham taxminan −$1 mlrd atrofida. Avgust oyida BTC ETF lari $3,5 mlrd kirim yozgan. BTC juma sessiyasida $79 000 ostiga tushib, keyin ~$79 700 atrofida tiklandi.

Manba: SoSoValue, Cointelegraph, CryptoBriefing.
